basics.name: Daynier Rodríguez Ruíz
basics.headline: Systems & IT Support Technician | Microsoft Azure | Cybersecurity | Databases | Applied AI

summary: Systems and network technician with 10+ years of experience in systems administration, networking and support (national telecom operator and own business), working with hardware since 2006. Holds official Spanish Professional Certificates in IT Systems Operation (IFCT0210) and Database Administration (IFCT0310, level 3); currently studying the Higher Technician degree in Networked IT Systems Administration (ASIR). Cybersecurity training (Google, Cisco) and preparing for the Microsoft Azure AZ-104 certification. Uses generative AI and agents daily (Claude Code, self-built MCP servers, Ollama) to automate systems tasks, with a security mindset and human review of every result. Focused on systems administration, L1/L2 support, cloud and cybersecurity.

skills.name: Cloud (Microsoft Azure, AZ-104 lab in Bicep)

experience.context: Leading nationwide telecare provider; 24/7 service in a regulated environment (health data, GDPR).
highlights: 24/7 monitoring of the telecare platform and handling of alarms and incidents, escalating to systems according to procedure.
Applied information security, data protection (GDPR) and service continuity procedures in a healthcare environment.
Coordinated with operations, systems and user support teams to resolve incidents in real time.
Optimized critical queries in SQL Server and MySQL through indexing, execution plan analysis and refactoring.
Automated backups and restore tests with scripts, keeping a traceable log of every restore.
Wrote technical documentation and trained internal users on query best practices.
Designed, installed and maintained secure LAN/WLAN networks for 50+ business and residential clients.
Assembled, diagnosed and repaired hardware and Windows/Linux operating systems (hardware experience since 2006).
End-to-end client management: remote and on-site support, quotes, warranties and user training.
Monitored the provincial network infrastructure serving 1,000+ concurrent users.
Introduced monitoring and incident response procedures aimed at reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) and critical incidents.
Trained junior technicians in cybersecurity and Windows/Linux systems administration.
